quick: Reduce to 60 mg OD if impaired
summary: Fexofenadine is a non-sedating second-generation H1 antihistamine for allergic rhinitis and chronic urticaria. Dosed 60 mg twice daily or 180 mg once daily, on an empty stomach. Avoid fruit juices which reduce absorption. Reduce dose in renal impairment.
indications: Seasonal allergic rhinitis (relief of sneezing, rhinorrhea, itchy/watery eyes, nasal/throat itching)
Chronic idiopathic urticaria (relief of itching and hives)
Relief of nasal/sinus congestion symptoms (combination products with pseudoephedrine)

dosage.d: 60 mg twice daily or 180 mg once daily
180 mg once daily or 60 mg twice daily

admin: Take with water on an empty stomach
Do not take with fruit juices (apple, orange, grapefruit) - reduce absorption
Swallow tablet whole; do not crush or chew
Separate from aluminum/magnesium antacids by ~2 hours
Take regularly during allergy season for best control
moa: Selectively antagonizes peripheral histamine H1 receptors, blocking histamine-mediated allergic responses (vasodilation, increased vascular permeability, pruritus, sneezing). As a non-sedating agent it minimally crosses the blood-brain barrier and lacks significant anticholinergic activity. It is the active metabolite of terfenadine.

relative: Phenylketonuria (some orally disintegrating formulations contain phenylalanine)

preg: Use only if clearly needed; human data limited. Loratadine/cetirizine often preferred when antihistamine required in pregnancy.
lact: Considered low risk; small amounts in breast milk. Generally compatible with breastfeeding at usual doses.
renal: Reduce dose in renal impairment: adults 60 mg once daily; reduce frequency in children. Lower clearance increases exposure.
hepatic: No dose adjustment needed; fexofenadine undergoes minimal hepatic metabolism and is largely excreted unchanged.

major: No clinically significant major interactions (does not prolong QT, unlike its parent terfenadine)
moderate: Erythromycin / ketoconazole - increased fexofenadine plasma levels (not clinically significant)
minor: Aluminum/magnesium antacids - reduced absorption; separate dosing
interactions.food: Fruit juices (apple, orange, grapefruit) and high-fat meals reduce absorption; take on an empty stomach.
interactions.diagnostics: Discontinue 3-4 days before allergy skin testing to avoid false-negative results.

pk: Store at 20-25 C, protect from moisture
pearls: Truly non-sedating; preferred when alertness needed

missed: Take the missed dose when remembered. If it is almost time for the next dose, skip it; do not double up.
overdose: Overdose may cause dizziness, drowsiness and dry mouth. No specific antidote; treat supportively with standard measures. Hemodialysis does not effectively remove fexofenadine.
